title.en: Find magnifying power of simple and compound microscopes
Find magnifying power and length of a telescope

say.en: Two lenses can show you a bacterium or the rings of Saturn. The microscope and the telescope use the same idea in opposite ways. In this lesson: Find magnifying power of simple and compound microscopes.
Find magnifying power and length of a telescope.
Compare refracting and reflecting telescopes.

body.en: A simple microscope is a convex lens held close to the eye. Its magnifying power is $m = 1 + D/f$ with the image at the near point ($D = 25$ cm) and $m = D/f$ with the image at infinity. A compound microscope has a short-focus objective that forms a real, magnified image, and an eyepiece that magnifies it further: $m \approx (L/f_o)(D/f_e)$, where $L$ is the tube length.
body.kn: ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದ ವರ್ಧನಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ m = 1 + D/f (ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬ). ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e).

narration.en: A simple microscope is a convex lens held close to the eye. Its magnifying power is m = 1 + D/f with the image at the near point (D = 25 cm) and m = D/f with the image at infinity. A compound microscope has a short-focus objective that forms a real, magnified image, and an eyepiece that magnifies it further: m \approx (L/f_o)(D/f_e), where L is the tube length.
narration.kn: ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದ ವರ್ಧನಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ m = 1 + D/f (ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬ). ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m ≈ (L/f_o)(D/f_e).

say.en: A simple microscope is a convex lens held close to the eye. Its magnifying power is m equals 1 plus D over f with the image at the near point D equals 25 centimetres and m equals D over f with the image at infinity. A compound microscope has a short-focus objective that forms a real, magnified image, and an eyepiece that magnifies it further: m \approx (L over f o)(D over f e), where L is the tube length. Simple: m equals 1 plus D over f near point, D over f infinity.
say.kn: ಸರಳ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದ ವರ್ಧನಾ ಸಾಮರ್ಥ್ಯ m equals 1 plus D over f (ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದುವಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬ). ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m is approximately (L over f o)(D over f e).

say.en: Compound: m equals m o times m e is approximately (L over f o)(D over f e).

narration.en: Let us sketch a compound microscope and a telescope and find their magnifying powers.

say.en: A compound microscope: a short-focus objective makes a real, enlarged first image; the eyepiece magnifies it further, like a simple magnifier.
The magnification is the objective's times the eyepiece's. With L = 15 cm, f_o = 2 cm and f_e = 5 cm, m is about 37.5.
A telescope: a long-focus objective forms an image of a distant object at its focus; the eyepiece views it. In normal adjustment the tube length is f_o + f_e.
The angular magnification is f_o over f_e. With f_o = 100 cm and f_e = 5 cm, m = 20 and the tube is 105 cm long.
Let us sketch a compound microscope and a telescope and find their magnifying powers.

narration.en: Parallel light from a distant star is focused by the objective (focal length fo) to an image at its focus. The eyepiece (fe) acts as a magnifier. In normal adjustment the final rays come out parallel and M = fo/fe, tube length fo + fe. With the final image at 25 cm, M = (fo/fe)(1 + fe/25). Angles are exaggerated.
narration.kn: ಖಗೋಳ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕ. ಸ್ಲೈಡರ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸರಿಸಿ, ಓದುಗಳು ಹೇಗೆ ಬದಲಾಗುತ್ತವೆ ಎಂದು ಗಮನಿಸಿ.

caption.en: Parallel light from a distant star is focused by the objective (focal length fo) to an image at its focus. The eyepiece (fe) acts as a magnifier. In normal adjustment the final rays come out parallel and M = fo/fe, tube length fo + fe. With the final image at 25 cm, M = (fo/fe)(1 + fe/25). Angles are exaggerated.
caption.kn: ದೂರದ ನಕ್ಷತ್ರದ ಸಮಾಂತರ ಬೆಳಕನ್ನು ವಸ್ತು ಮಸೂರ (fo) ತನ್ನ ನಾಭಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಬಿಂಬವಾಗಿಸುತ್ತದೆ. ನೇತ್ರ ಮಸೂರ (fe) ವರ್ಧಕದಂತೆ. ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ಹೊಂದಾಣಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅಂತಿಮ ಕಿರಣಗಳು ಸಮಾಂತರ, M = fo/fe, ನಳಿಕೆ ಉದ್ದ fo + fe. ಅಂತಿಮ ಬಿಂಬ 25 cm ನಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ M = (fo/fe)(1 + fe/25).

say.en: Parallel light from a distant star is focused by the objective focal length fo to an image at its focus. The eyepiece fe acts as a magnifier. In normal adjustment the final rays come out parallel and M equals fo over fe, tube length fo plus fe. With the final image at 25 centimetres, M equals (fo over fe)(1 plus fe over 25). Angles are exaggerated.

body.en: An astronomical telescope has a long-focus objective and a short-focus eyepiece. In normal adjustment (final image at infinity) its magnifying power is $m = f_o/f_e$ and its length is $f_o + f_e$. Reflecting *telescopes* use a concave mirror as the objective: there is no chromatic aberration, a paraboloid mirror removes spherical aberration, and a large mirror is easier to support than a large lens.
body.kn: ಖಗೋಳ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m = f_o/f_e ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದ f_o + f_e. ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣ ವಿಪಥನ ಇಲ್ಲ.

points.en: Large objective aperture gives better resolution and brightness

narration.en: An astronomical telescope has a long-focus objective and a short-focus eyepiece. In normal adjustment (final image at infinity) its magnifying power is m = f_o/f_e and its length is f_o + f_e. Reflecting telescopes use a concave mirror as the objective: there is no chromatic aberration, a paraboloid mirror removes spherical aberration, and a large mirror is easier to support than a large lens.
narration.kn: ಖಗೋಳ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m = f_o/f_e ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದ f_o + f_e. ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣ ವಿಪಥನ ಇಲ್ಲ.

say.en: An astronomical telescope has a long-focus objective and a short-focus eyepiece. In normal adjustment final image at infinity its magnifying power is m equals f o over f e and its length is f o plus f e. Reflecting telescopes use a concave mirror as the objective: there is no chromatic aberration, a paraboloid mirror removes spherical aberration, and a large mirror is easier to support than a large lens. m equals f o over f e, length equals f o plus f e.
say.kn: ಖಗೋಳ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ m equals f o over f e ಮತ್ತು ಉದ್ದ f o plus f e. ಪ್ರತಿಫಲಕ ದೂರದರ್ಶಕದಲ್ಲಿ ವರ್ಣ ವಿಪಥನ ಇಲ್ಲ.

The cornea and lens form a real image on the retina, and the ciliary muscles change the lens's focal length so we can see from far away down to the near point, D = 25 cm, used in m = D/f. Try this: Open the inside view and find the cornea, the lens and the retina; then explain why the image on the retina is upside down.
caption.kn: ಪ್ರತಿ ದೃಕ್ ಉಪಕರಣವೂ ಕಣ್ಣಿನಲ್ಲಿ ಕೊನೆಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ. ಕಾರ್ನಿಯಾ ಮತ್ತು ಮಸೂರ ಅಕ್ಷಿಪಟಲದ ಮೇಲೆ ನೈಜ ಬಿಂಬ ರೂಪಿಸುತ್ತವೆ; ಸಿಲಿಯರಿ ಸ್ನಾಯುಗಳು ಮಸೂರದ ನಾಭಿದೂರ ಬದಲಿಸಿ ದೂರದಿಂದ ಹಿಡಿದು ಸಮೀಪ ಬಿಂದು D = 25 cm ವರೆಗೆ ನೋಡಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತವೆ; m = D/f ನಲ್ಲಿ ಬಳಸುವ D ಇದೇ. ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ: ಒಳಗಿನ ನೋಟ ತೆರೆದು ಕಾರ್ನಿಯಾ, ಮಸೂರ ಮತ್ತು ಅಕ್ಷಿಪಟಲ ಹುಡುಕಿ; ಅಕ್ಷಿಪಟಲದ ಮೇಲಿನ ಬಿಂಬ ಏಕೆ ತಲೆಕೆಳಗಾಗಿದೆ ಎಂದು ವಿವರಿಸಿ.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A compound microscope has f_o = 0.8 cm, f_e = 2.5 cm and tube length 16 cm. Find its magnifying power for the final image at infinity.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A compound microscope has f o equals 0.8 centimetres, f e equals 2.5 centimetres and tube length 16 centimetres. Find its magnifying power for the final image at infinity.
m o equals L over f o equals 16 over 0.8 equals 20.
m e equals D over f e equals 25 over 2.5 equals 10.
m equals 20 times 10 equals 200.
So the answer is 200.

problem.en: A telescope has an objective of focal length 150 cm and an eyepiece of 5 cm. Find its magnifying power and length in normal adjustment.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. A telescope has an objective of focal length 150 cm and an eyepiece of 5 cm. Find its magnifying power and length in normal adjustment.

say.en: Let us solve this together. A telescope has an objective of focal length 150 centimetres and an eyepiece of 5 centimetres. Find its magnifying power and length in normal adjustment.
m equals f o over f e equals 150 over 5 equals 30.
Length equals 150 plus 5 equals 155 centimetres.
So the answer is m equals 30, length equals 155 centimetres.

body.en: Microscope: both lenses short. Telescope: objective long, eyepiece short. If you remember that m grows when the eyepiece focal length is small, you have both.
